Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: 单人全身照. Create ONE full-length front-facing standing studio photograph, camera level and undistorted portrait-lens perspective, head upright, relaxed neutral expression, shoulders level, arms naturally at sides, hands empty. Entire hair to soles visible with 4–6% margins. Approximately SEVEN-AND-A-HALF (7.5) HEADS TALL measured from anatomical skull crown (not piled hair) to chin, elegant tall balanced model-like proportions with healthy natural build. Natural waist around 38–39% down from crown, crotch around 48–49%, knees around 73%; legs subtly long but proportional, torso not excessively long or short, normal head size and feet. Avoid squat short legs, huge head, tiny torso, stretched legs or eight/nine-head extreme runway proportions. Preserve apparent age: for the clearly young girl retain age-appropriate youthful anatomy and clothing. Vertical 2:3 native 1024x1536, soft grounded shadow, full body sharply visible. Keep the exact reference upper garment; complete the lower outfit specified.
IDENTITY AND STYLE: Brown low updo with face-framing strands, brown eyes, strong brows. Slight variation: warm brunette low bun, champagne pleated blouse with wide shoulder coverage and modest neckline, small crystal studs and fine silver necklace.
LOWER OUTFIT: warm taupe high-waisted straight-leg tailored trousers and champagne low-heeled shoes.
Reference image defines the exact approved person, face, hairstyle, apparent age and upper clothing. Preserve identity, eye color, face shape, hairline, skin tone, hair and accessory design precisely. Same individual in every view, never a generic lookalike. Bright soft neutral frontal studio lighting and equal fill, consistent exposure with clear eyes and no dark face. Pure white seamless background, real fine skin and hair detail, no painterly texture or plastic skin. No text, labels, watermark, collage of different people, props, bags or added accessories. Infer unseen garment construction conservatively and consistently.  USER PROPORTION CORRECTION: previous adult full-body versions looked short-legged. Increase visible leg length, aiming for a harmonious 7.5-head tall fashion-model silhouette. Moderately compact torso, natural high waist, long thighs and calves, normal head and healthy natural limbs. Avoid long tops that visually lower the waist. Preserve recognizable face, age, outfit style and real anatomy. HARMONY CHECK: anatomical head height about one seventh-and-a-half of standing height; healthy natural shoulders about 2.4–2.7 head-widths across, proportionate ribcage and pelvis. Do not shrink the shoulders or body around an oversized head. Elegant healthy slender build, not frail, pinched, tiny or emaciated. Hair volume is not the anatomical head size. Coherent head-neck-shoulder connection.
